Take your seat

Pick a chip, choose your numbers and watch the wheel. You have 10 seconds to place your bets.

The wheel
Bet on 1, 2, 5 or 10. A match pays the shown odds and returns your winning stake. Bets close when the timer ends.
Chance
A gift or a multiplier for the next spin. With a multiplier, your bets stay on the table. You cannot bet directly on Chance.
2 Rolls & 4 Rolls
A matching bonus bet takes you into the city. Collect the multipliers on each stop. Doubles add a roll, except when leaving jail. Leave jail with doubles or after three attempts.

Made for fun. Deposits add game coins only, with no cash value. Your balance stays in this browser. By default, every wheel segment has an equal chance.
